_provenance.source: Reconstructed pre-section-06 prompt baseline for the v19 spec (approach (b) per section-06 implementation plan).
_provenance.reconstruction_note: The B+C plan's §7.1 specified removing three admin-markup instruction blocks (views/admin/settings.ejs, views/admin/<slug>/new.ejs + edit.ejs, and the dashboard settings section). Today's repo does not carry them as distinct blocks; this baseline splices back simulated representative versions of those blocks so the 10% reduction claim is anchored to the intended pre-pruning state. See the section-06 implementation plan, 'Implementation constraints' bullet on the token-count fixture for the approach-(b) protocol.
_provenance.counted_via: len(prompt_string) - simple character count proxy; 10% drop threshold is proportional.
